name: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd

calls.error: filing is a cover letter, not the transcript

ledger.quote: The second plant at the Kharkhoda facility and the fourth production line at the Hansalpur facility in Gujarat is set to become operational within this financial year.
ledger.speaker: Rahul Bharti
ledger.target: Operationalize Kharkhoda plant 2 and Gujarat line 4
ledger.verdict: Kharkhoda plant 2 and Gujarat line 4 are targeted by this financial year.

ledger.quote: Besides, the company has put plans in place to increase the production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.
ledger.speaker: Rahul Bharti
ledger.verdict: Capacity expansion to 4 million units is targeted for the medium term.

ledger.quote: Aligned with Suzuki's global vision, we plan to introduce multiple EVs and to support this, our aim is to enable a network of over 1 lakh charging points across India by 2030, along with our dealers and charge point operators.
ledger.speaker: Rahul Bharti
ledger.verdict: Over 1 lakh charging points are targeted by 2030.

ledger.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.
ledger.speaker: Rahul Bharti
ledger.verdict: Due by March 2027. Running ahead so far, but the period it covers hasn't ended.

ledger.quote: Overall, on the capex for FY 26-27, we are looking at a INR14,000 crores capex for the full year.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Roy
ledger.verdict: Capex of INR14,000 crores is targeted for FY 26-27.

read: There is too little settled yet to judge this management's word. The annual growth target is kept, while capacity, EV infrastructure and capex deadlines fall due later.
questions: Are Kharkhoda plant 2 and Gujarat line 4 on schedule to open this financial year?
What is the current progress toward the 14,000 crore capex target for FY 26-27?
bull: Revenue grew 26 percent year-on-year in Sep 2026 to 53,356 crore.
Debt to equity remains at 0.0 with minimal borrowings of 83 crore.
bear: Operating profit margin declined to 9 percent in Sep 2026.
Profit after tax fell to 2,466 crore in Sep 2026 from 3,349 crore in Sep 2025.
